objective: Implement and test every open issue in refactory-dsh, in ranked order, verified against the circle_packing + annealing_pack running example
rule: Do not stop while any item below is not 'done'. test_work_complete.py fails otherwise, and it requires every item to name its issue, its verification command, and (once done) the evidence observed.
ordered_by: correctness first, then the runtime, then the API, then independent tracks, then the generators, then the future work

items.title: History access, and refuse a proposal that reproduces an existing state (E-duplicate)
items.why: A real bug: duplicates are silently dropped by step(), so batch slots are lost and the run overstates what it tried. Also the prerequisite for the OuterLoop run handle.
items.evidence: 173 passed. tests/test_history.py is new (12 tests): read_run from report.json, the per-candidate fallback for a run with no report, truncation reported, find_runs newest-first and excluding the current run, the context's history/tried/prior_runs, and the prompt carrying both new sections. E-duplicate is refused at the optimizer layer (test_optim.py, 4 new tests) and asserted never to reach step()'s defensive path (attempt == 0), so the slot is refused at the right layer. A real random-optimizer run on circle_packing/adaptive left coded refusals in rejections.jsonl with no lost slot. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_history.py refactory/tests/test_optim.py -q

items.title: str knobs are invisible to the random optimizer and to init's sweep
items.why: Closes the 'declared = optimizable' guarantee, which is the rule the whole seam rests on.
items.evidence: 185 passed. tests/test_str_knobs.py is new (12 tests): an open str knob is sampled by textual mutation and never returns the current value; a str knob with declared values picks one of them; every kind (int, float, bool, str, enum) returns a sample; values validation rejects a non-str kind; the spec round-trips values; the random optimizer proposes string knobs across 40 seeds; the starting sweep includes them; a narrow optimizer is warned about by name at init and reported in knob_coverage; describe() names values and range separately and no longer has an overloaded bounds. A real run on circle_packing/adaptive reports knob_coverage.unreachable == [] and leaves the example test green. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_str_knobs.py refactory/tests/test_example.py -q

items.title: Path-aware evaluation integrity, and the validator's rules stated in the optimizer prompt
items.why: The metric guard is weaker than designed (graph-wide, not path-aware), and every run wastes attempts rediscovering V1-V10.
items.evidence: 218 passed. tests/test_integrity.py is new (12 tests): on_path_nodes excludes a region that cannot reach a terminal; a producer off every path no longer satisfies fact_produced (and V3 does not fire, so it fails on the path); a producer on a path satisfies it; a read satisfied only off-path is refused as V6; the running example's seed still validates. The rules reach the optimizer: a test asserts every code the validator emits appears in RULES and vice versa (AST-parsed, both directions), and that the prompt states V4-V10. summarise_reasons is tested to put the mode-declared rule first and to state the collapsed count. A real autoresearch run used the new prompt: 0 refusals, and its diagnosis cited a previous run's result. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_integrity.py -q

items.title: Mode authoring surface: declared memory with retention, ports, declared surface
items.why: Cross-run priors need somewhere declared to live; the GUI needs to know what a mode publishes.
items.evidence: 218 passed. tests/test_declarations.py is new (17 tests): memory namespace/kind/retention validation, port validation, spec round trips, a run-scoped memory is invisible to another run while a project-scoped one is visible, forget_run_scoped names what it dropped and is quiet the second time, a project memory survives it, kinds cannot be misused, an undeclared namespace is refused, a map keeps keys. V11 refuses a declared port no node on a path writes and accepts one that is written; ports and memory travel in the state and round trip; the report names both and the run records which ports it produced. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_declarations.py -q

items.title: Run durability: artifact schema version, and resume from an append-only log
items.why: A crash loses the run, and unversioned artifacts make an old report read as current.

items.title: Lower the mode state dict to refactory's IR and run it on DSH
items.why: The stated target: DSH is the runtime, the Python walker is a debug runtime.

items.title: Two extension points (Optimizer, OuterLoop) plus all 13 SRF strategies ported
items.why: The search research surface. The abstraction is proven by the ports, not by tests of the abstraction.

items.title: Package lifecycle: import, add, remove, enable/disable; workspace root; provenance and trust
items.why: A regression against the deleted glue, and generated packages currently land in the source tree.

items.title: Generated packages execute as trusted code
items.why: create-mode imports and runs model-written Python with no isolation; the old system sandboxed candidates.

items.title: Optimizer-facing signals: author priors, refusal findings, block signals, no-op as convergence
items.why: Makes the search better; none of it makes it correct, which is why it follows the correctness work.

items.title: Run and visualise the outer loop from the GUI, with the loop staying Pythonic
items.why: A user must be able to start a run and read what came out without a terminal.

items.title: create-mode: survey, strategy, design review, then emit
items.why: It is a stub next to create-v2: no research, no strategy, no design review.

items.title: design-v2: the third meta-mode, emitting software rather than a package
items.why: A named deliverable of the original product with no replacement.

items.title: Edit an existing mode from a brief, with provenance and a before/after score
items.why: The honest middle path between creating from scratch and hoping a random edit lands.

items.title: Stretch: express the outer loop as a refactory mode
items.why: Future work, but the OuterLoop surface is chosen so this is a lowering rather than a rewrite.
